answer: Each numbered ledge slot for relic or saffron storage costs one fixed-supply token burned per round and carries one vote. Keys get no free votes. A contract checks burns, the public rental registry and renter signatures; each slot counts once. Conflicting renter-signed ballots for one slot in a round cancel its vote before tallying, without refund. Parallel clones and colluders need another token and slot per extra vote. A coalition buying over half the votes wins majority decisions; no unique-human proof.
